jyutping: zi6 jin4 wui5 kaau3 gan6 A

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a person or thing tends to move toward a person or target.

examples.english: When I see fresh desserts, I naturally gravitate toward them.
examples.traditional: 見到有新鮮嘅甜品，我自然會靠近嗰邊。
